title: India Geopolitical Risk Monitor (IGRM) — daily press-salience index, 2017-present
subtitle: Daily press-salience percentiles for five registered channels of India-relevant geopolitics, with a pre-registered validation record, published baselines, and per-article receipts.
description:
IGRM measures press salience: the share of global news coverage matching five registered channel dictionaries (Pakistan border, China border, Gulf & energy, US & trade, shipping chokepoints), each ranked against its own trailing two years. It is NOT a measure of risk and makes no forecasts.

Construction is fully registered before use: dictionaries, episode rules, and validation lists are frozen ex-ante with append-only amendments; the full pipeline is open (MIT) and reproducible in ~5 minutes from a checkout (REPLICATION.md). Validation: 24 of 29 pre-registered episodes detected; misses published. Read that against its published baselines: 6.8 hits expected by chance, 19 of 29 under strict start-based timing, and 26 of 29 for a naive detector that asks only whether any channel moved. The naive rule scores higher, so the registered record is evidence of channel attribution, not of detection. Sampling uncertainty ships as Wilson 95% bands. Comparison: monthly co-movement with Caldara-Iacoviello's GPR-India is r=0.48 despite zero shared pipeline; this is convergent behavior between related measures, not validation.

Columns (history.csv): date; composite and five channel percentiles (0-100, trailing-730-day rank). Refreshed daily by ~06:00 IST at https://igrm.in with a public reliability record.

Citation: Krishna, Ishan (2026). India Geopolitical Risk Monitor. https://igrm.in/

resources.description: Daily composite + five channel percentiles since 2017; the live version is https://igrm.in/data/history.csv
